newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sanyo says Thai output not hit by fire.
newsitem.headline: Sanyo says Thai output not hit by fire.

text.p: Sanyo Universal Electric, whose warehouse building and office complex near Bangkok were torched by disgruntled employees overnight, said on Wednesday that its production line was unaffected by fire.
"The fire will have no impact on the company's production as it caused no damage to the production line." said the company in a statement to the Thai stock exchange.
Trading in the company's stocks was halted for the morning session by the bourse as it awaited clarification from the company on the arson.
